_doc: Theme names. The build clusters highlights by meaning (k-means), then names each cluster after the closest description below; clusters with the same closest name merge into one theme. Edit names/descriptions freely.

themes.MAKING: design, software, code, AI agents and prompts, photography, cameras and lighting, creative tools and craft
themes.ECONOMY: economics, capitalism, growth, poverty and development, countries and policy, China, globalisation, inequality and income
themes.SOCIETY: society, power, morality, politics, freedom, social groups, status and human behaviour in groups
